forward.notes: PROVISIONAL full-route model: mean body-forward movement 0.699m over four 4.01-second motions at [0.130,0.200], estimated 0.1744m/s; separate individual measurements 0.750,0.734,0.663,0.650m. Previous independent tests yielded 0.19949m/s. Needs short verification on this hardware/surface; forward speed may vary by leg.

left.notes: Post-deterioration painter-tape condition; 0.70s left 93/86 degrees and 1.40s left 182 degrees. Through-origin fallback 129.29 deg/s. Current mechanical setup is not verified safe; yaw accuracy does not establish translation accuracy. Waypoint 0->2 physical test succeeded, but left turn produced estimated 0.05-0.15 m translation toward negative world y; direct center-of-rotation model remains uncalibrated.

right.notes: Post-deterioration painter-tape condition; 0.90s clockwise 86/87 degrees; 2.10s 170 and 2.20s 182/188 degrees. Right-turn speed is duration dependent; 84.45 deg/s is a single-rate FALLBACK ONLY. Piecewise anchors require accompanying updated waypoint_controller.py. Right rear wheel fault not mechanically cleared. Timing VERIFIED BY YAW TRIALS in current painter-tape configuration: 0.90s right yielded 86/87 deg; 2.10s yielded 170 deg and 2.20s yielded 182/188 deg. Mechanical safety remains UNVERIFIED.

hardware_condition: right-rear wheel previously barely moved; painter tape applied in latest trials; exact mechanical effect and safety of tape not established; do not operate a bound or taped-over rotating wheel

route_observation.left_turn_shift_measurement: user-estimated during waypoint 0->2 run; not a separately measured chassis pose correction
route_observation.caution: Wheel issue and painter-tape workaround have not been mechanically cleared; do not restrain any wheel/shaft or operate if wheel stalls.
route_observation.full_run_qualitative: All 6 segments executed and broad route direction recognizable, but position deviations were large and accumulated. User reports first 3 turns biased somewhat left.
route_observation.wp4_uncertainty: Visual rough estimate at end of translation from (2,1) to (2,2), BEFORE final heading turn, during full six-leg run. Not enough to attribute to forward undershoot vs prior-turn translation vs heading error.
route_observation.turn_model_status: effective pivot FITTED from measured four turns, enabled; separate left/right pivots; two turn samples per direction, uncertain
route_observation.measured_checkpoint_sequence: calibration/route_checkpoints.csv; 8 before/after action poses with center in meters and heading degrees, robot center measured manually
route_observation.checkpoint_refers_to: after right ~180 degree turn at (2,2), not full route final waypoint

turn_center_shift.notes: ENABLED: fitted 2D effective pivot separately for left and right from four within-route turn observations (world center x/y before/after, and measured body yaw). 2 left actual rotations +86/+76deg and 2 right -70/-174deg; least-squares pivot model. These are fitted equivalent 90deg body-frame shifts, not directly measured 90deg samples. TURN SHIFTS ARE VARIABLE; this remains open-loop, no feedback. Validate with short supervised segment runs and ensure workspace clearance.
